name: AdInsight / Clarity
description: Adds the Microsoft Clarity / AdInsight analytics/heatmap tracking script.
project_description:
Adds the AdInsight Clarity visitor level call statistics tracking system to your Drupal site.

 This module exposes a telephone number element as:

 
 A Block 
 A Filter 
 A Token 
 A span element that you can manually insert into your markup 
 
 The telephone number is dynamically updated via JavaScript such that each visitor is shown a unique telephone number for their session from the number pool in your account.

 If you also have Google Analytics enabled, the AdInsight script will fire events into Google Analytics when people call the dynamically inserted telephone numbers

 Note: AdInsight Clarity is a subscription service and you must have an AdInsight account for this module to function correctly.

 Name change: AdInsight has changed its name to ResponseTap
